node: Student finance, loan servicing, repayment administration, and affordability infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the underfollowed public-company universe around regulated education-finance operations rather than education content. The strongest scarce-supplier pattern is not a single material input, but compliance-heavy servicing, payment-plan administration, campus payment infrastructure, cross-border tuition rails, and employer tuition/student-loan benefit administration. The two-lane funnel yields one contextual government-services servicer, plus three more direct underfollowed candidates with payment, servicing, or employer-benefit infrastructure exposure. No buy/sell view is implied.
